text:
This guidance provides an overview of the Competition and Markets Authority’s (CMA) role, functions and powers in relation to consumer protection.

It covers:

our approach to enforcing consumer protection law

our consumer protection powers, including direct enforcement powers, civil court-based enforcement powers, criminal powers and investigatory powers

how we engage with others (both in the UK and internationally) on consumer protection issues

Read our simple guide to how we gather information about potential breaches of consumer law.
